record_scope_reconstruction: Habur–Ibrahim Khalil is one paired road crossing. Turkish freight policy and Iraqi-side admission of Turkish drivers in their own trucks are separate phases.

source_checks.finding: Turkish ministry June4 announcement refers to international freight and commercial vehicles, not proof of ordinary passenger restoration.
19 August report explains March1 contact-free swaps, Turkish June4 permission, later Iraqi-side permission and actual driver-accompanied crossings.
Hauliers association specifies August19 19:00 Turkish-driver entry to Iraq, continued freight exchanges before then, and testing.
